name: io.github.CakeRepository/1password
description: MCP server for 1Password credentials — tools and resources for vaults and credentials

environmentVariables.name: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: 1Password service account token. Use this or the Connect host/token pair.
